indicator_rule: Indicators meet Gentry's test. Lists stay flat (Grabo). Automated alerts (PAGER, GDACS) are estimates that are revised; a revision is recorded, never hidden.
emerging_concerns: A hazard with an orange or red alert in a country no program watches goes to Watchfloor's review queue.

indicators.text: USGS PAGER alert of yellow or worse
indicators.rule: alert is yellow, orange or red

indicators.text: GDACS alert of orange or red

indicators.rule: a new activation in the area

indicators.text: An automated alert is lowered or withdrawn on revision
indicators.rule: a later update lowers the alert

indicators.text: A US nuclear facility declares an NRC emergency class
indicators.rule: emergency class Unusual Event, Alert, Site Area Emergency or General Emergency, not retracted

indicators.text: A US power reactor unit reported at 0% after 20% or more the report before
indicators.rule: 0% on the newest report after 20% or more, within 72 hours, on a unit whose earlier day pairs show such drops on 5% or fewer
indicators.baseline: the unit's own earlier day pairs (rolling, up to 30)

indicators.text: An NRC event notification is retracted, or its emergency is reported terminated
indicators.rule: the event's text carries a retraction or reports the emergency terminated

warning_problems.title: A natural hazard becomes a disaster (anywhere)

watch_condition.current: set per event from EL-IND-1 to EL-IND-3

warning_problems.issue_on_change: Issue a notice when an event's alert rises or an activation opens; stay silent while it holds.
warning_problems.deactivation: Back to normal when the alerts are lowered and any activation closes.

hypotheses.statement: Major human impact (deaths, displacement, lifelines down)
A large hazard with limited impact (remote, prepared or offshore)
Artefact: an automated estimate later revised down

warning_problems.title: A radiological emergency at a US nuclear facility
warning_problems.proposed: Drafted with the NRC lane (method elements-feed-1.2); for the program owner to confirm or change

watch_condition.current: set per facility from EL-IND-5 and EL-IND-6

warning_problems.issue_on_change: Issue a notice when a facility declares an emergency class or a later report raises it; stay silent while it holds.
warning_problems.deactivation: Back to normal when the report is retracted or the emergency reported terminated, and the 72-hour hold has passed.

hypotheses.statement: A threat off the site: a Site Area or General Emergency
An emergency declared and ended on the site (an Unusual Event or Alert, then terminated)
A reactor stopped with no emergency declared
Artefact: a licensee's report later retracted, or a status figure corrected (the NRC publishes both unevaluated)
